dataset.name: ImageNet-1K 256x256 plus OpenAI guided-diffusion FID reference
dataset.source: ImageNet manual license download and OpenAI VIRTUAL_imagenet256_labeled.npz
manual_requirements: IMAGENET_ROOT with train/ and val/ folders

baseline.name: VAR-d16
baseline.command: sample 50,000 PNG files with cfg=1.5/top_p=0.96/top_k=900, pack to npz, then run OpenAI guided-diffusion evaluator
baseline.notes: The repository states the sampling script will be provided later, so baseline_eval.sh intentionally requires SAMPLE_NPZ and GUIDED_DIFFUSION_EVAL_DIR.
